files.name: main.py
files.code:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("sales_dirty.csv")
print(df.shape)
print(df.isna().sum())             # thiếu bao nhiêu mỗi cột
print(df.duplicated().sum(), "dòng trùng")
print(df["region"].unique())       # phát hiện: "south", " East "...

clean = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
clean["region"] = clean["region"].str.strip().str.title()      # chuẩn hoá chữ
clean["units"] = clean["units"].fillna(clean["units"].median())
clean = clean.dropna(subset=["category"])
print(clean.shape, clean.isna().sum().sum())

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("sales_dirty.csv")
clean = df.drop_duplicates().copy()
clean["region"] = clean["region"].str.strip().str.title()
clean["units"] = clean["units"].fillna(clean["units"].median())
clean = clean.dropna(subset=["category"])
print(clean.shape)
